tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search NudiTok for adult videos (porn, NSFW, nude, 18+), hashtags and creators by keyword.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Fetch metadata for one NudiTok video by hash. Returns page_url to link to (no direct media URL).

tools.name: get_feed
tools.description: Get a sample of the newest public adult videos on NudiTok (max 20).

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: Get trending adult videos on NudiTok by engagement for a time window (max 20).

tools.name: list_creators
tools.description: Browse the public NudiTok creator directory by follower count (max 20).

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List the most popular adult hashtag categories on NudiTok by video count (max 20).

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Fetch a NudiTok creator's public profile plus their newest videos.
